provenance.note: Colors, per-shape availability and element IDs are read from the Rebrickable catalog, not estimated: a color is listed only in the brick shapes LEGO has actually issued an element for, and every (color, brick) pair carries that element ID. BrickLink color IDs are the exception — Rebrickable's color numbering is its own and does not convert, so they come from the hand-maintained data/bricklink-color-ids.csv and are unverified; colors missing from that table carry null rather than a guessed value. Regenerate with `npm run palette:build`.
